title: Report Cards: Qualitative Evaluation of Language Models Using Natural Language Summaries

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the effect of presentation order on the LLM judge's evaluations and assessing how Chain of Thought (CoT) prompting helps mitigate this ordering bias during contrastive model comparisons.

De-stylizing model completions via paraphrasing to remove unique syntactical patterns, then measuring the contrastive accuracy to determine if the evaluation relies on surface-level stylistic features rather than substantive model capabilities.
